verdict.rationale: Stripe's agentic-commerce docs specify concrete webhook events tied to agent-driven flows — `checkout.session.completed` for agent orders, `shared_payment.issued_token.used`/state-transition webhooks for SPTs, `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` for embedded checkout, and `v2.commerce.product_catalog.imports` succeeded/failed webhooks for catalog syncs — showing a buyer/developer can subscribe to and act on these events. Missing for 10: explicit generic webhook-endpoint setup/signature-verification docs in this pack and independent/hands-on confirmation that agent-specific webhook subscriptions work reliably in production.
